scope: Original-client manual save after a complete independent existing first-Admin Read; not product Export, Linux grants, model effects or installed qualification
command: save-enrolled-snapshot INSTALLATION ROOT RELATIVE_PATH EXACT_BYTES SHA256 NEW_ABSOLUTE_TARGET
implementation: The existing service authenticates and reviews its original first-Admin-owned local NTFS Read; all chunks and final receipt/whole SHA256 must validate before one-use ownership transfer, at most 1048576 bytes

Read pipe closes before the independent manual action; its receipt supplies no filesystem or service-side Export authority. No current-source re-read, background action, model, publication or inference grant is implied

A fresh nonrenewable 30-second original-client action binds the entire completed source, fresh nonce, actual primary-token/logon/session fingerprint and held target/ancestor/owner-DACL identity to an exact human SAVE hash

Actual original local Windows account SID/flags, active unlocked interactive session, primary-token identity and enabled ACL-bypass privileges are checked throughout; impersonation and service identities refuse

The ordinary original client, never SYSTEM, creates a new no-follow exclusive owner/SYSTEM-only protected-DACL NTFS output under held ancestors. Existing files, hard links, aliases, streams, reparse/cloud/recall/offline or changed objects refuse

Actual protected target volume identity and BitLocker state are rechecked with bounded sampling; unknown/suspended/unprotected state refuses. This is not enterprise authorization or an atomic encryption-state reservation

Bounded writes, flush and complete length/SHA256 readback precede success. Cancellation or failure never claims completion, retries automatically, overwrites or deletes the named possible partial file

Manual binary data uses a full-file hash rather than raising the intentionally smaller wire-frame hash limit. The separate 4096-byte UTF8 inference handoff remains unchanged and mutually exclusive with this transfer

verification.unregistered_in_progress_workspace_file: HostedAuthorityWorkspace.cs is inventoried but is not compiled, used or claimed by this component

retained_failed_attempt.reason: One-MiB test correctly refused the wire-frame hash helper's smaller input bound; implementation and fixture now use explicit SHA256 for full file data, leaving wire bounds unchanged

limitations: NTFS fixtures exercise actual files, metadata, chunks and readback with controlled current-authority callbacks. They do not replace actual first-Admin authentication, protected UTC, live BitLocker/provider behavior or installed service/client qualification.
Synchronous kernel/provider hard deadlines and zero-exposure protection transitions are not claimed. A failed or cancelled named partial file is retained for manual inspection.
General ordinary-user product principal/grants and content publication remain GWIN1 scope. The first-launch account/health/manual workspace implementation remains a separate development component.
